reviews.title: Excellent for video editing and Ai upscaling.
reviews.comment: Works flawlessly. Had to return the ASUS GeForce 5060 ti as it was not compatible with the software I use for video editing. This one solved all those issues. Fast rending and excellent results using Ai video upscaling.
reviews.author: Big T in Tennessee

reviews.title: This graphic card combines the past and future.
reviews.comment: Awesome graphic card renders a new life to my vintage pc. Games from couple years ago can run much more smoothly compared to the clunky performance with my previous RTX 2070. Besides, the price is very favorable for a brand new card. I wish Amazon had more stock of this card as it helps revive those desktop pcs from 5-6 years ago.
reviews.author: Mr. Cai

reviews.title: I highly recommend
reviews.comment:
GREAT GPU I LOVE IT AND I GAVE ME A 6 PACK AFTER 7 MINUTES OF USE
The graphics quality is great I'm able to play games like cyberpunk on max settings while maintaining normal or better framerate, the card fits nicely into my motherboard (ASUS TUF Gaming Z790-Plus WiFi) and case (ASUS TUF Gaming GT502 ATX Mid-Tower).
So overall playability for games is great, Setting up and using it is easy, and it survived my untrained self making a pc so yeah its durable.
